services.desc: Newport Beach is one of the few places in California where you can get on the water in any month and have a genuinely good time. With around 280 sunny days a year and a harbor that stays calm year-round, there is rarely a bad day to rent a boat here. That said, each season brings something different, and knowing what to expect helps you plan a trip that actually matches what you are looking for. Spring is quietly the best time to rent a boat in Newport Beach if you want great weather without peak-season crowds.
